name: Chorus.ai
description: Chorus by ZoomInfo is a conversation intelligence platform for recording, analyzing, and coaching from customer interactions. Revenue teams use it to review meetings and calls, understand engagement patterns, share moments, and improve sales execution.
agentUseSummary: Add a dedicated user-bound Chorus.ai API token, then let selected agents read up to 25 minimized engagement summaries in a date range capped at 31 days. Relay does not expose participants, transcripts, recordings, trackers, emails, users, moments, exports, integrations, pagination tokens, arbitrary API access, or writes.

credentialRequirements.label: Chorus.ai API token
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use a dedicated user-bound token whose Chorus role and data controls grant only the intended recordings; Relay encrypts it server-side.

capabilities.label: Read engagement summaries
capabilities.description: Use one pinned GET /v3/engagements request for up to 25 minimized summaries in a date range capped at 31 days.

allowed.label: Read Chorus.ai engagement summaries
allowed.description: Read up to 25 minimized engagement summaries within a validated date range of at most 31 days.

blocked.label: Change Chorus.ai
blocked.description: Uploads, recording deletion, users, playlists, moments, scorecards, integrations, exports, and every mutation are outside Relay's V1 contract.

blocked.label: Read conversation content or people
blocked.description: Participants, owner identity, transcripts, utterances, recordings, media, trackers, emails, meeting URLs, and custom data are blocked.

blocked.label: Use arbitrary API requests
blocked.description: Continuation-key paging, ranges over 31 days, arbitrary filters, custom routes, and raw API access are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Bounded engagement-summary reads run directly. Participants, transcripts, recordings, trackers, email, users, paging, exports, and every mutation remain blocked.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts one typed engagement-summary tool through the encrypted customer-owned Chorus.ai API token.
Railway mounts one typed engagement-summary tool through the encrypted customer-owned Chorus.ai API token.

providerSetup.blocker: No customer-owned Chorus organization, dedicated least-privilege user, API-enabled role, user-bound token, representative non-private engagement fixtures, or data-access-control matrix is available in this workspace.
providerSetup.nextAction: A Chorus administrator grants API access to a dedicated least-privilege role, configures its recording data controls, creates a user-bound token, saves it through Relay Console, then verifies the bounded metadata read, private-recording exclusion, role and data-control enforcement, date validation, minimization, agent assignment, token rotation, disconnect, rate errors, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Chorus documents a REST API authenticated by user-bound API tokens, role-gated token creation, user traceability, exclusion of private recordings, enforcement of the token user's data controls and action permissions, and a broad read/write surface that Relay narrows.

The official collection documents GET /v3/engagements with min_date, max_date, tracker, identity, duration, compliance, type, and continuation-key inputs alongside destructive and upload operations; Relay exposes only dates and forces trackers off.
The official collection documents bounded page sizes for playlist reads and broad playlist mutations, illustrating the wider content surface that Relay does not mount.
